$description: The look of every host app, taken from a host app (clients/desktop), which is the reference. W3C Design Tokens format: each token has $value, $type and $description. Colours are hex, with two more digits for alpha; dimensions are CSS pixels (a host app's points at 100% zoom); durations are milliseconds. design/README.md says how the apps read it.

sidebar.$description: The sidebar and the window's frame around the page.

background.$description: The page, inside its rounded panel.

foreground.$description: Text, icons, and the primary button's fill.

card.$description: Cards, rows' backgrounds, menus, dialogs and sheets.

secondary.$description: Muted fills: the current tab, a selected segment, a menu's hover, popovers in cards.

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text: summaries, hints, times, placeholders.

border.$description: Lines between rows, card and panel borders.

input.$description: A field's border, a checkbox's outline.

ring.$description: A focused field's border; its 3-point glow is this at 50%.

live.$description: Working, connected, ready: the success colour.

attention.$description: Something waits for the owner: requests, a repository's server, a code about to expire.

destructive.$description: Errors, and what can't be undone.

warning-text.$description: A warning's icon and words on dark ground.

success-text.$description: A done step's tick and words.

success-fill.$description: A solid success badge (an agent that's ready).

warning.$description: The base of warning callouts; drawn at 8% to 40% (see warning-fill and warning-line).

field-on-card.$description: A field's fill on a card or sheet: input at 30% over card, opaque so a focus ring stays a ring.

field-on-page.$description: A search box's fill on the page: secondary at 60% over background, opaque.

hover.$description: A row's hover and the current page: foreground at 5%.

overlay-line.$description: A menu's, popover's or dialog's border: foreground at 10%.

input-fill.$description: A field's fill on the page: input at 30%.

tile-fill.$description: A choice tile's fill: secondary at 50%.

muted-70.$description: A sidebar row's time: muted-foreground at 70%.

warning-fill.$description: A warning callout's fill: warning at 10%.

warning-line.$description: A warning callout's border: warning at 25%.

scrim.$description: Under a sheet or dialog: black at 10%, with what's under it blurred 4 points.

scrim-strong.$description: Under a modal that must be answered (the private sign-in): black at 48%.

syntax.$description: Code's colours (gpui-core's syntax_* colours), each at least 4.5:1 against background, card and secondary in its theme; the light theme's is $extensions.light.

callout.$description: Callouts in a doc (GitHub's five alerts, gpui-core's callout colours): each kind's colour for its icon, title and edge, and its background, the colour at 8%. The light theme's is $extensions.light.

note.$description: A note: information to notice even when skimming.

note-background.$description: A note callout's background: its colour at 8%.

tip.$description: A tip: a better or easier way to do something.

tip-background.$description: A tip callout's background: its colour at 8%.

important-background.$description: A important callout's background: its colour at 8%.

warning.$description: A warning: urgent, needing attention to avoid problems.

warning-background.$description: A warning callout's background: its colour at 8%.

caution.$description: Caution: the risks or bad outcomes of an action.

caution-background.$description: A caution callout's background: its colour at 8%.

body.$description: Everything but code. Bundled as four fixed weights.

mono.$description: Code, commands, paths, addresses and one-time codes.

base.$description: The base size: section titles, dialog titles. Every size scales with it under zoom.

sm.$description: Body text: rows' titles, fields, buttons, the chat.

xs.$description: Summaries, hints, labels of sidebar sections, small buttons' captions.

title.$description: Line height over size for title (30 on 22.5).

base.$description: Line height over size for base.

sm.$description: Line height over size for sm (Tailwind's 1.25rem on 0.875rem).

xs.$description: Line height over size for xs (Tailwind's 1rem on 0.75rem).

relaxed.$description: Long text: a page's lede, a passage.

1.$description: The unit; spacing comes in its multiples.

1.5.$description: A label to its field; a button's icon to its words.

2.$description: Between buttons; the window's frame around the page.

3.$description: A row's icon to its words; a field's text inset.

4.$description: A row's sides; a dialog's padding.

6.$description: Between a form's groups; a sheet's sides.

8.$description: A page's title to its first section.

12.$description: Between a page's sections; the page's top.

card.$description: A chat card (an agent's OpenUI card).

frame.$description: The window's frame between its edge and the page's panel; the panel's corner is the window's less this.

sidebar-width.$description: The sidebar's width by default (it's dragged between 220 and 480).

thinking.$description: Working text (Thinking, a step's verb) fades to 60% and back.

easing.$description: Ease in and out, each half.

low.$description: The text's opacity at its faintest.

dots.$description: A working agent's three dots bounce a quarter of their height.

stagger.$description: Between one dot and the next.

press.$description: A hover's or press's colour change.

pause.$description: Typing pauses this long before a search runs.

note.$description: How long a button says Copied.

blur.$description: The blur under a sheet or dialog.
